fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/op and internal/check: a note with a discusses link to a node and one to a change set fold and check clean; a discusses link from a non-note is refused; the field schema knows note's fields; describe-golden.txtar and the guide's count of kinds and link types are updated
fields.statement: The model has a note node kind, with its body in statement and an optional op field, and a discusses link type from a note to any node or change set

fields.acceptance: change-notes.txtar: note add on a node, on a change set, and on a change set with --op each pass fold-ok and rhiza check; a note on an unknown target exits 2; --op naming an operation not in the target change set exits 2
fields.statement: rhiza note add <target> <text> [--op id] writes a note discussing a node or change set (and naming an operation with --op) into the current change set in one entry

fields.acceptance: change-notes.txtar: after two notes on a node and one on a change set, show lists the node's two in order with actor and time, and change show lists the change set's note
fields.statement: rhiza show and rhiza change show list the notes that discuss the node or change set, oldest first, with actor and time
